platforms.name: Windows
platforms.requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Cleanup runs on your graphics card (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel, through Vulkan), or on the processor if there isn’t a usable one. The installer isn’t signed yet, so if Windows SmartScreen warns, choose More info, then Run anyway.
platforms.pending: The Windows installer is being tested now. It will appear here as soon as it’s ready.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.requirements: 64-bit x86 and a recent distribution (glibc 2.43 or newer, such as Ubuntu 26.04) with GTK 3, libxdo, Vulkan and PipeWire; KDE Plasma or GNOME on Wayland, or X11. Unpack it and run ./install.sh. On an older system, build it from source (below).
platforms.pending: There’s no ready-made Linux build yet. You can build and install it from source today: see below.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.pending: macOS support is planned after Windows.
